_comment: Nightly gates, calibrated to DATASET v4 dev split after the quality push (secrag-v9, 2026-07-18: dev faithfulness 0.901, relevancy 0.825, recall 0.873, precision 0.839, source_recall 1.0, source_precision 0.891). Floors sit ~0.05-0.10 below measured values to absorb judge noise (measured re-judge variance: faithfulness +-0.001 aggregate, context_recall +-0.07) while catching real regressions. Recalibrate whenever the dataset version changes - thresholds are meaningless across dataset versions.
